purpose: Determine whether any reproducible real-world probability signal exists beyond a timestamped market-only baseline using the cheapest scientifically valid development sample.

sample_design.selection_rule: chronological contiguous races from one or more predeclared meetings; no outcome-aware inclusion/exclusion
sample_design.meeting_boundary_policy: keep complete selected meeting-days where feasible to reduce cherry-picking
sample_design.replacement_rule: only objective source-unavailability or regime-ineligibility; replacement must be next chronological eligible race and recorded before outcome scoring

market_inputs.preferred: complete timestamp-proven 3-rentan quote surface at one fixed pre-race cutoff
market_inputs.fallback: a different complete sold-market probability surface may be used only if frozen before outcomes and all models are compared on the same races/market
market_inputs.late_market_movement: separate research feature; not required for first M0 baseline

terminal_rule: Do not score outcomes until sample membership, PRE inputs, market cutoff, provenance and hashes are frozen under an authority that explicitly permits development outcome attachment.
